about: Mechanized Diataxis documentation model for Verdant Engine: maps all seven stakeholders in app/src/Architecture.lex.tex to guide personas, defines engine glossary terms, and configures plain-language and accessibility checks.

personas.name: Kai
personas.need: A runnable 3D game world with ECS, XPBD physics, neuromorphic attention, spatial audio, and a starter template.

asks.discover: What can Verdant Engine build in the browser and in Rust?
asks.evaluate: Does verdant-core give me real 3D physics, GLB import, culling, and asset export?
asks.learn: Walk me from an empty Cargo crate to a running 3D scene.
asks.build: How do I spawn entities, step physics, and export a scene?
asks.scale: How do I keep simulation deterministic across rollback frames?

personas.name: Iris
personas.need: External GLB scene ingestion, skeletal rigs, validated portable WGSL shaders, and progressive UORC transcoding.

asks.discover: Which 3D geometry, material, streaming, and shader standards does the engine speak?
asks.evaluate: Do imported and exported GLB scenes round-trip cleanly?
asks.learn: Show me how terrain heightfields, procedural meshes, and multi-LOD streams are generated.
asks.build: How do I import GLB scenes, validate WGSL shaders, and pack UORC files?
asks.scale: How are morph targets and mesh normals kept valid across progressive LODs?

personas.name: Mira
personas.need: Verified 2D screen-space and 3D diegetic interfaces with 48px touch targets, WCAG contrast, and reachable focus graphs.

asks.discover: How does Verdant Engine model 2D HUDs and 3D diegetic panels in the same engine?
asks.evaluate: Can non-compliant touch targets or low-contrast widgets be rejected before shipping?
asks.learn: How does the tropical (max, +) solver compute intrinsic widget sizes?
asks.build: How do I verify a UiTree and raycast diegetic world panels against the BVH?
asks.scale: How do UI compliance guarantees hold across phone, tablet, and desktop viewports?

personas.name: Otto
personas.need: Fifteen unified uor-matmul semiring kernels, zero-copy Wasm buffers, 60fps worker budgets, and zero magic constants.

asks.discover: How is the runtime split across crates, workers, tensor kernels, and frame stages?
asks.evaluate: Are tensor accumulators, frame budgets, snapshots, and UORC decode buffers bounded?
asks.learn: Where does each subsystem live in crates/verdant-core?
asks.build: Which types execute tensor contractions, solve UI bounds, and shard Stitch payloads?
asks.scale: What are the exact API signatures, error variants, and frame limits?

personas.name: Vera
personas.need: Proof that UORC streaming is monotonic, capability grants enforce denial-wins, and Stitch shards verify SHA-256 seals.

asks.discover: What invariants govern tensor contractions, container grants, and asset safety?
asks.evaluate: How are UORC SHA-256 chains, Prism ID journals, and Stitch parity shards verified?
asks.learn: How does exact integer accumulation eliminate drift across devices?
asks.build: What refuses a corrupted UORC stream, denied container API, or tampered shard?
asks.scale: How does the browser worker isolate and verify the engine archive?

personas.name: Wren
personas.need: A responsive 60fps 3D viewport with progressive UORC streaming, mutual-attention camera framing, and spatial audio.

asks.discover: How does Verdant Engine stream high-resolution 3D worlds smoothly in every browser?
asks.evaluate: Does the 3D viewport stay responsive on phones and desktops without special GPU flags?
asks.learn: How do camera modes, progressive LOD scrubbing, and local SLM commands work?
asks.build: Which canonical 3D engine nodes and neuromorphic gimbals run inside the studio?
asks.scale: How does cold boot stay within the 120 KiB mobile transfer budget?

personas.name: Sol
personas.need: Self-custodied Foundry Prism ID sessions, 2-of-3 Stitch parity shards, and deterministic peer rollback rooms.

asks.discover: How do players co-inhabit shared 3D worlds without central account servers?
asks.evaluate: Does my Prism ID private key stay non-extractable inside my browser?
asks.learn: How does Stitch reconstruct a world snapshot when one of three peers goes offline?
asks.build: How do signed input journals synchronize across tabs and peer rooms?
asks.scale: How does survival-entropy tracking schedule proactive shard refreshes?

reading.tutorial: A tutorial: follow the steps in order. Each step builds on the one before it.
reading.howToGuide: A how-to guide: each section completes one practical engine task.
reading.reference: Reference: look up types, budgets, and commands in any order.
reading.explanation: Explanation: read end to end to understand the design and physics.
reading.home: Start here. Choose your role or jump straight to a tutorial, guide, or API reference.

terms.plain: The entity-component-system container in verdant-core that stores entities, parent-child transforms, meshes, and PBR materials.
A tree of 3D bounding boxes partitioned by surface area so raycasts, diegetic UI picks, and camera frustum checks skip distant geometry.
The W3C portable shading language whose modules are parsed and type-checked in Verdant Engine by naga.
The Khronos Group 3D scene transmission standard. GLB is its single-file binary container.
Universal Object Reference Compression: progressive SHA-256 chain-verified multi-frame compression streaming 3D scenes up to lossless resolution.
A deterministic binary save of tick count, streaming LOD rank, and entity transforms protected by a 32-byte SHA-256 digest.
